title: The Gamecock (film)
text: The Gamecock is a 1964 film directed by Pasquale Festa Campanile. It was one of his earlier directorial works. The film is a drama and is unrelated to any monster or creature feature.

title: Monster a Go-Go
text: Monster a Go-Go is a 1965 American science fiction horror film directed by Bill Rebane and Herschell Gordon Lewis. The film concerns an astronaut who returns to Earth transformed into a monster.

title: Pasquale Festa Campanile
text: Pasquale Festa Campanile was an Italian film director, screenwriter and novelist. He was born on 28 July 1927 in Melfi, Italy, and died on 25 February 1986. He directed The Gamecock in 1964.

title: Herschell Gordon Lewis
text: Herschell Gordon Lewis was an American filmmaker often called the Godfather of Gore. He was born on 15 June 1926 in Chicago, Illinois, and died on 26 September 2016. He co-directed Monster a Go-Go.

title: Bill Rebane
text: Bill Rebane is an American film director born in 1937 in Riga, Latvia. He is best known for low-budget films and co-directed Monster a Go-Go with Herschell Gordon Lewis.

title: The Mask of the Gorilla
text: The Mask of the Gorilla is a 1958 French crime film. It has no connection to Monster a Go-Go or The Gamecock and features no astronauts.

title: The Capture of Bigfoot
text: The Capture of Bigfoot is a 1979 American horror film directed by Bill Rebane. It is about a legendary snow creature and is unrelated to The Gamecock.

title: Monster from the Ocean Floor
text: Monster from the Ocean Floor is a 1954 American science fiction film. It is often confused with other monster films of the era but has a distinct plot and crew.

title: John V, Prince of Anhalt-Zerbst
text: John V, Prince of Anhalt-Zerbst was a German prince of the House of Ascania. He was born on 4 September 1504 in Dessau and died on 4 February 1551 in Zerbst. He was the son of Ernest I, Prince of Anhalt-Dessau. His eldest son was Karl I, Prince of Anhalt-Zerbst.

title: Ernest I, Prince of Anhalt-Dessau
text: Ernest I, Prince of Anhalt-Dessau was a German prince of the House of Ascania. He died on 12 June 1516 in Dessau. He was the father of John V, Prince of Anhalt-Zerbst.

title: Karl I, Prince of Anhalt-Zerbst
text: Karl I, Prince of Anhalt-Zerbst was a German prince. He was the eldest son of John V, Prince of Anhalt-Zerbst and succeeded to the principality of Anhalt-Zerbst.

title: Margarete of Munsterberg
text: Margarete of Munsterberg was the daughter of Henry I, Duke of Munsterberg-Oels. She was the mother of John V, Prince of Anhalt-Zerbst. This page is a distractor for questions about John V's father.

title: House of Ascania
text: The House of Ascania was a dynasty of German rulers. Members included princes of Anhalt-Dessau and Anhalt-Zerbst. It is a broad category page and does not by itself state individual birth or death dates.

title: Joachim I Nestor, Elector of Brandenburg
text: Joachim I Nestor was Elector of Brandenburg. His daughter Margaret of Brandenburg married John V, Prince of Anhalt-Zerbst. He is unrelated to the film questions.

title: Godfather of Gore
text: The Godfather of Gore is a nickname associated with Herschell Gordon Lewis for his splatter films. This page is about the nickname and does not itself list birth dates.

title: Melfi
text: Melfi is a town in the Basilicata region of southern Italy. It is the birthplace of the film director Pasquale Festa Campanile. This page is a geographic distractor.
